featured_individuals.sentence: Three concurrent life sentences without parole
featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Helping coordinate a drug deal / Drug Conspiracy (non-violent, first-time offense role)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Clarence Aaron was sentenced to three concurrent life sentences without parole for a non-violent drug conspiracy. His sentence was commuted in 2013, and he was released in 2014 after serving approximately 20 years. The case highlighted extreme sentencing laws and issues with the clemency process.
contributing_factors_raw: Potential mishandling of initial clemency petition
organizations_involved_raw: Advocacy reported by ProPublica, Washington Post
